alternative_results.name: left_valve
alternative_results.reason: Keeping either valve of an individual is equivalent.

alternative_results.name: mean_of_valves
alternative_results.reason: Averaging both valves is a defensible individual value; averaging logged values agrees within tolerance.

sufficiency_witness: Some individuals are represented by both valves (shared individual_id); valves of one animal are not independent observations, so each individual contributes once (either valve, or their mean).
analysis_specification: Join measurements to the catalogue by specimen_id. Use one value per individual: the right valve where both valves were measured. RMA of log10(height) on log10(length); report slope, intercept and n.
